messages.subject: Project Quartz — engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct you on the acquisition of Velloran Hygiene Limited, a Warrington-based maker of industrial and healthcare hygiene products. Founder-owned (Geoffrey and Patricia Velloran) with a 20% minority held by Aldermarsh Nominees. Indicative enterprise value around £42.5m, cash-free debt-free. We'd run it through a new bidco. Can your team take this on?

Best,
Daniel
